content.value: An ISP is granted a block of addresses starting with 190.100.0.0/16. The ISP needs to (13) distribute these addresses to 3 groups of customers:
i) 1st group: 52 customers, each needs 128 addresses.
ii) 2ⁿd group: 40 customers, each needs 256 addresses.
iii) $3 ^ { \mathrm { r d } }$ group: 100 customers, each needs 64 addresses. How many addresses are still unallocated? Note down the network addresses of each group.
